name: nova
description: NOVA: a personal AI assistant for home and servers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nova/api" "npm run dev -w @nova/web"
scripts.dev:background: mkdir -p dev-data && setsid nohup npm run dev > dev-data/dev.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo "NOVA dev: $( [ -f dev-data/certs/cert.pem ] && echo https || echo http )://$(hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1):5173  (log: dev-data/dev.log, stop: npm run dev:stop)"
scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f "[c]oncurrently -k -n api,web"; pkill -f "[n]est start --watch"; pkill -f "[v]ite dev"; pkill -f "[a]pps/api/dist/main"; echo "NOVA dev stopped"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nova/web && npm run build -w @nova/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nova/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @nova/api && npm run check -w @nova/web
